tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

tools.description: Run, test, and visually verify iOS apps in the iOS Simulator on this Mac. Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. 'attach' opens a live panel so the user can watch — when the user wants to see the app, call 'attach' FIRST, before building: it is cheap, opens instantly on a booted simulator, and errors harmlessly when nothing is booted (boot or build, then retry it). Use this whenever the user wants to see or try their iOS app — "run my app", "test this on iPhone", "does this look right?", "try the new screen" — not only when they mention the simulator by name. Coordinates are in device points (origin top-left); the 'launch' result reports the device's point dimensions.

action.description: What to do. 'attach' opens the live simulator panel for the user — call it BEFORE you build or launch, as soon as the user wants to see the app: on a booted simulator it opens immediately, and otherwise it returns a clear, harmless error (boot or build first, then retry it). Do not skip the early attach because 'launch' also attaches — the panel should be open before the build starts. The panel is the user's view, not a precondition — 'screenshot' and input actions work without it. Skip it only when the user has no interest in watching; 'launch' installs and launches an .app (it also re-attaches, but call 'attach' early rather than relying on that); 'screenshot' returns a PNG of the current screen; 'tap'/'swipe'/'text'/'button' inject input; 'press_key' presses a hardware key 'count' times: return, delete (backspace), an arrow, select_all, undo or redo (a key also hides the on-screen keyboard); 'set_appearance' switches the device to light or dark mode; 'appearance' says which it is in; 'set_keyboard' shows or hides the on-screen keyboard (it appears only while a text field has focus, and 'press_key' and 'text' hide it again); 'rotate' turns the device a quarter turn left or right ('direction'); take a 'screenshot' after it and tap in that screenshot's frame, however it comes back; 'touch_path' performs a single-finger drag along an arbitrary path (eased curves, long-press-then-drag); 'touch2_path' is the two-finger variant for pinch/rotate; 'open_url' opens a deep link; 'detach' closes the panel/stream. NOTE: a 'swipe' or 'touch_path' whose start point is on-screen and within 4pt of an edge performs the OS edge gesture instead of a plain drag — left=back, top=notification shade, bottom=home/app-switcher, right=Control Center (mapped to the current interface orientation). Start more than 4pt from the edge to drag or scroll content near the bezel.

app_path.description: For 'launch': path to the built .app bundle (e.g. DerivedData/.../Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/MyApp.app).

device.description: Simulator name (e.g. 'iPhone 17 Pro') or UDID. Defaults to the simulator already attached, else the first booted one. The first use of a device asks the user for permission.

udid.description: Alias for 'device' (identical semantics: simulator name or UDID). Pass at most one of 'device' / 'udid'.

bundle_id.description: For 'launch': bundle identifier. If omitted, extracted from the .app's Info.plist.

points.description: For 'touch_path': touch path samples in device points. First point is touch-down; last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

points2.description: For 'touch2_path': two-finger path samples in device points. Each sample carries both contacts (x1/y1, x2/y2); first is touch-down, last is touch-up. dt_ms is the delay before that sample (0-1000 ms; the first sample's is skipped, so send 0 or omit it; at most 30 seconds in all).

duration.description: Seconds. For 'tap', >0.5 is a long-press. For 'swipe', the gesture duration (default 0.3).

key.description: For 'press_key': the key or edit command to press.

count.description: For 'press_key': how many times to press it, 1 to 20 (default 1).

state.description: For 'set_keyboard': 'show' or 'hide' the on-screen keyboard. For 'set_appearance': 'light' or 'dark'.

url.description: For 'open_url': URL or scheme to open in the simulator.

loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. Pandemic growth model — NOT ['Simulating patient zero', 'Modeling the curve'] (documentary-narrator voice), YES ['Setting up the model', 'Running the calculation']. Cancer timeline — NOT ['Charting the battle ahead'], YES ['Laying out the stages']. If you have to ask whether it's serious, it is. Otherwise, have fun — reach for alliteration, puns, personification, wordplay, whatever lands in that language. Playful examples — revenue chart: ['Bribing bars to stand taller', 'Asking Q4 where it went']; kanban: ['Herding cards into columns', 'Dragging, dropping, not stopping'].

title.description: Short snake_case identifier for this visual. Must be specific and disambiguating — if the conversation has multiple visuals, this title alone should tell you which one is being referenced (e.g. 'q4_revenue_by_product_line' not 'chart', 'oauth_login_flow' not 'diagram'). Also used as the download filename, so no spaces or special characters.

widget_code.description: SVG or HTML code to render. For SVG: raw SVG code starting with <svg> tag, must use CSS variables for colors. Example: <svg viewBox="0 0 700 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">...</svg>. For HTML: raw HTML content to render, do NOT include DOCTYPE, <html>, <head>, or <body> tags. Use CSS variables for theming. Keep background transparent and avoid top-level padding. Scripts are supported but execute after streaming completes.

1	# MM-03.3 v0.2, jalon 1, passe 5 : finitions (stockage statique, forme vide, arènes dans `Reachable`) (rapport d'exploration v0.1, passe 5)
2	
3	Branche `formal/access_model_0.1`, à la suite de la passe 4 (dernier commit de passe 4 : `474d03b`). Module `formal/Ern/MM03.lean`, espace de noms `Ern.MM03`. `formal/Ern/MM02.lean` est inchangé : `git diff 474d03b -- formal/Ern/MM02.lean` est vide.
4	
5	Sources :
6	- MM-03.3 v0.2 (`ERN_Memory_Model_0.3.3.md`, hors dépôt) ;
7	- les arbitrages A1 à A11, B1 à B10 et C1 à C9, toujours en vigueur ;
8	- les arbitrages D1 à D4 de cette tâche, qui les complètent et font foi.
9	
10	Le rapport de passe 4 est `formal/reports/MM03_v0.1_p4.md`. Ses décisions et questions sont citées sous la forme « passe 4, (c) n ».
11	
12	## État de la vérification
13	
14	| Contrôle | Résultat |
15	|---|---|
16	| `lake build` | réussit, sans avertissement |
17	| `sorry`, `admit`, `axiom`, `native_decide`, `noncomputable` | aucun dans `formal/` |
18	| `#print axioms` sur les 455 théorèmes | au plus `propext` et `Quot.sound` : 363 utilisent les deux, 83 `propext` seul, 9 aucun ; `Classical.choice` n'apparaît nulle part |
19	| `example` | 278, tous vérifiés par le build : les 208 de la passe 4, plus 70 nouveaux |
20	
21	## Résultats principaux
22	
23	1. **Stockage statique (D1).** L'état initial `S3.init statics` porte le stockage statique : ses éléments suivent l'encodage des locaux de `enterFrame`, avec un état initial par feuille. Le cadre 0, qui ne sort jamais, les possède. Pour toute forme statique valide (`ShapeOK 0`), l'état initial satisfait `WF3 ∧ Inv3` (`init_wf`). `Reachable` part de `S3.init statics`, et `StaticPinnedBottom` a maintenant un contenu sur un état atteint (`staticPinned_reached`).
24	2. **Arènes dans `Reachable` (D3).** L'état porte les entrées d'arène. `newArena`, `issue` et `reset` sont des pas de `Reachable`. `reachable_access_invariant_underDD` conclut `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ ∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ArenaInv s ar`. Les cas 16 et n4 sont rejoués comme une exécution de `Reachable` depuis `S3.init []`, arène comprise (`case16_reachable`).
25	3. **Forme vide (D2).** `alloc []` est rejeté. Un `alloc` accepté crée toujours une racine (`alloc_ok_new_root`).
26	4. **Ré-ancrage (D4).** À la sortie, une autorité survivante ne change que d'origine, une autorité qui ne survit pas ne change que d'activité. Aucune ne change de mode, d'empreinte ni de détenteur (`exitG_keeps_modes_footprints`). Une autorité `Modify` survivante retire toujours le droit effectif à ses ancêtres survivants (`exit_keeps_restrictions`).
27	5. **Deux demandes ne sont pas réalisables telles qu'écrites.**
28	   - L'arène imbriquée du cas de la tâche, avec un enfant de valeur arène distincte de celle du parent : dans le modèle, l'enfant a toujours la valeur arène du parent (`nested_same_value`). Le module teste la seule forme réalisable. Voir (d) 2 et (e) 2.
29	   - « Le cadre 0 possède exactement les emplacements statiques et leur stockage possédé » : prouvé pour la possession directe. Pour un statique possédé par un autre statique, la possession par le cadre 0 n'est pas invariante (`static_not_owned_by_frame0`). Voir (d) 1 et (e) 1.
30	
31	## Commits
32	
33	| Commit | Contenu |
34	|---|---|
35	| `89cdd43` | Étape 1 (D1) : `S3.init statics`, `init_wf`, `Reachable` depuis `S3.init statics`, `reachable_base_owns_statics`, `staticPinned_reached` |
36	| `d193c76` | Étape 2 (D2) : `alloc` rejette la forme vide ; `alloc_ok_new_root` |
37	| `0158451` | Étape 3 (D3) : entrées d'arène dans l'état, `newArena`, `issue` et `reset` dans `Reachable`, invariant étendu, `arena_entry_follows_transfer`, `arena_dies_with_internal` |
38	| `c3ff257` | Étape 4 (D4) : `exitG_keeps_modes_footprints`, `effective_none_of_desc_modify`, `exit_keeps_restrictions` |
39	| `24f23b8` | Étape 5 : cas |

41	| commit de ce rapport | Rapport, corrections de la vérification |

43	## Corrections après la revue adverse
44	
45	La revue a réparti la recherche entre quatre lectures :
46	- D1 ;
47	- D2 et D4 ;
48	- D3 ;
49	- intégrité des énoncés et des cas.
50	
51	Chaque lecture a été soumise à un juge chargé de réfuter ses constats, qui a relancé les témoins Lean. Huit décisions de conception étaient soumises explicitement à la revue ; leurs numéros, cités dans cette section, correspondent dans ce rapport à : (1) → (c) 2, (2) → (c) 7, (3) → (c) 8, (4) → (c) 9, (5) → (c) 10, (6) → (c) 14, (7) → (d) 2, (8) → (c) 16. Sur 14 constats, 3 ont été confirmés et 6 l'ont été en partie.
52

29	   - `alloc []` → `reject` ; `alloc` d'une forme à une feuille → `ok` ;
30	   - cas 16 et n4 rejoués comme exécutions de `Reachable` depuis `S3.init`, introduction de l'arène comprise (`alloc`, `newArena`, `issue`…), avec une liste d'arènes non vide à chaque état vérifié ;
31	   - `transfer` de la valeur arène puis `issue` par le nouveau propriétaire → `ok` ; `endUse` de la valeur arène puis `issue` → `reject` ;

6646	    OptP (s.P[storage]?) (fun pl => y.holder = pl.owner) False ∧
6647	    (∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
6648	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ y.footprint) ∧
6649	    (y.origin = none ↔ parentOf s.P storage = none)) False

6659	/-- Preconditions of `newArena storage` (D3), in order: exercisable `Modify` on `storage`;

6662	of the new arena. -/

6664	  HasRight s .modify storage ∧ s.Usable storage ∧ OwnedStorage s storage ∧

6649	    (y.origin = none ↔ parentOf s.P storage = none)) False

/-- An arena entry (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3): `storage` is the place of the administered storage,
owned by the arena value; `internal` is the authority that administers it, the root of `storage`
or, for an arena nested in a block of another arena, that block (D3); `available` and `issued`
are the logical state of §6, `issued` mapping each issued region to the issued block. The owner
is not a field: it is the owner of `storage`, which follows transfers (A5). The anchor of §6 is
not a field either: dependents anchor on the blocks (A10). -/
structure Arena where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  available : List Nat
  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq

/-- State `S3 = (F, P, I, A, D)` (MM-03.3 §1), without component `M` (pass-1 arbitrage 1).
`nF` is the next frame identity, so that an exited frame is never reused. `D q` lists the
anchors of place `q`, each an authority identity (pass-1 arbitrage 2). `dead q`: the place is
logically dead (A6, `endUse` and `free`); `freed q`: its storage was released by `free` (A6);
`pin l`: leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (A8). `arenas`: the arena entries registered by
`newArena` (D3). -/
structure S3 where
----
  · exact h.elim

/-! ## Invariants (MM-03.3 §2, A1) -/

/-- I1, effective exclusivity strengthened structurally (MM-03.3 §2, A1): two distinct active
authorities, unrelated by `origin`, covering the same leaf, `SharedMutable` leaves included,
both have the proper mode `Observe`. The pass-1 statement on effective modes is the theorem
`effective_compat`. -/
def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- I2, conservation of authorities (MM-03.3 §2): the origin of a derived authority exists, and
on each leaf of the derived footprint, the leaf is in the footprint of the origin and the
derived mode does not exceed the origin's. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint ∧ y.mode.le x.mode

/-- I3, validity of dependencies (MM-03.3 §2): every anchor of a usable place is valid, that is,
active (pass-1 arbitrage 2). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- I4, validity of consumed values (MM-03.3 §2), first sentence as a state predicate: no
`Moved` leaf is readable. The other sentences concern `transfer` and are theorems. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ a p, s.I p = .moved → ¬ CanReadLeaf s a p

/-- `AnchorOrder` (B8 as corrected by C1): for every usable place and every anchor of it, the
frame of the effective anchor (`S3.effAnchor`, the root of the chain of origins) is the frame of
the place or one of its ancestors (MM-03.3.1, `ancestor`). It holds for every anchor. -/
def AnchorOrder (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4`, the invariant `Inv3` written in MM-03.3 §2, before the clause
`AnchorOrder` that B8 adds to it. -/
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- `NoDangling` (C2): no active authority covers a leaf of a place that is not usable in the sense
of `Usable` (existence, `dead` mark, chain of owners). It says nothing of initialisation: a leaf
`Uninit` or `Moved` of a usable place may stay covered. -/
def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

/-- `Inv3` (MM-03.3 §2; B8, C1, C2): the safety invariant,
`I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling`. -/
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

theorem Inv3.base {s : S3} (h : Inv3 s) : Inv3base s := h.1
theorem Inv3.ao {s : S3} (h : Inv3 s) : AnchorOrder s := h.2.1
theorem Inv3.nd {s : S3} (h : Inv3 s) : NoDangling s := h.2.2

/-- `AnchorOrder` read on the places of `P`: decidable form. -/
theorem anchorOrder_iff {s : S3} : AnchorOrder s ↔
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q) :=
  ⟨fun h q _ hq => h q hq, fun h q hq => h q (List.mem_range.2 hq.lt) hq⟩

/-- `NoDangling` read on the authorities of `A` and on the places containing each covered leaf:
decidable form. -/
theorem noDangling_iff {s : S3} : NoDangling s ↔
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active j → ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l →
      ∀ q ∈ l :: chain (parentOf s.P) l, s.Usable q := by
  constructor
  · intro h j _ ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ l hl hlP hleaf q hq
    have hl' : l ∈ y.footprint := by simpa [S3.afp, hy] using hl
    exact Decidable.byContradiction fun hu => h j y hy ya q hu l
      (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlP, (List.mem_cons.1 hq).imp Eq.symm id⟩) hl'
  · intro h j y hy ya q hu l hl hly
    obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, -, hq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
    exact hu (h j (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy)) ⟨y, hy, ya⟩ l
      (by simp only [S3.afp, hy]; exact hly) hlP hleaf q (List.mem_cons.2 (hq.imp Eq.symm id)))

/-- I4 holds in every state: the read condition requires `Init` (MM-03.3 §2, I4; §5). -/
theorem i4_always (s : S3) : I4 s := fun _ _ hm h => by rw [h.2.1] at hm; cases hm

/-- Root place (MM-03.3.2; B1): an existing place without parent. -/
def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none

instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- First clause of B1: two distinct root places have disjoint footprints. Parts and their
containing places are not concerned. -/
def RootsDisjoint (P : List Place) : Prop :=
  ∀ r r', RootPlace P r → RootPlace P r' → r ≠ r' → ∀ l ∈ footprint P r, l ∉ footprint P r'

/-- Second clause of B1: the chain of origins of an authority covering a leaf ends at the root
authority of the root place of that leaf, an authority without origin whose footprint is the
footprint of that root place. -/
def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- A4, "Une racine reste détenue par le propriétaire de son emplacement", a possession condition
that A1 keeps in `WF3`: an authority without origin is held by the owner of the root place of
every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-- `WF3` (A1, A4, B1, C3): well-formedness, the domain of admissible states, separate from the
safety invariant `Inv3`. Origins precede their derivations; footprints are made of existing
places; the stack is non-empty and without duplicates, below `nF`; owner frames are below `nF`;
owner places exist; a part comes after its parent and has its owner and its `dead` flag; every
active authority has a live holder (possession); B1: the chain of origins of an authority covering
a leaf ends at the root authority of its root place (`RootChain`); A4: a root is held by the owner
of its place (`RootHeld`). C3: the first clause of B1, `RootsDisjoint`, is not a clause: it holds
for every list of places (`rootsDisjoint_always`). -/
def WF3 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  (∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) ∧
  (∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, l < s.P.length) ∧
  s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ (∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f → f < s.nF) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
    o < s.P.length) ∧
  (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q) ∧
  (∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → HolderLive s y.holder) ∧
  RootChain s ∧ RootHeld s

/-- The pass-1 exclusivity on effective modes (MM-03.3 §2, I1) is a theorem under the
strengthened I1 (A1). -/
theorem effective_compat {s : S3} (h : I1 s) :
    ∀ a b p m₁ m₂, a ≠ b → effective s a p = some m₁ → effective s b p = some m₂ →
      Compat m₁ m₂ := by
  intro a b p m₁ m₂ hab ha hb
  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, xp, ex⟩ := effective_some ha
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya, yp, ey⟩ := effective_some hb
  have obs₁ : x.mode = .observe → m₁ = .observe := fun hm => by
    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
  have obs₂ : y.mode = .observe → m₂ = .observe := fun hm => by
    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
  by_cases hba : b ∈ s.ancs a
  · have hm : x.mode ∈ descModes s b p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨a, x, hx, xa, xp, hba, rfl⟩
    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · have : x.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
      exact ⟨obs₁ this, rfl⟩
  by_cases hab' : a ∈ s.ancs b
  · have hm : y.mode ∈ descModes s a p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨b, y, hy, ya, yp, hab', rfl⟩
    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · have : y.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
      exact ⟨rfl, obs₂ this⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hab' hba
  exact ⟨obs₁ h₁, obs₂ h₂⟩

/-- `effective_exclusive` (MM-03.3 §10): under I1, an authority with effective `Modify` on a leaf
is the only one with a present effective mode there. -/
theorem effective_exclusive {s : S3} (h : I1 s) {a b p : Nat} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : effective s a p = some .modify) : effective s b p = none := by
  cases hb : effective s b p with
  | none => rfl
  | some m => exact absurd (effective_compat h a b p _ _ hab ha hb).1 (by simp)

/-- `shared_keeps_exclusivity` (A9): I1 holds on `SharedMutable` leaves like on any other leaf:
two unrelated active authorities covering such a leaf are both in `Observe`. -/
theorem shared_keeps_exclusivity {k : K} {s : S3} (h : I1 s) {a b : Nat} {x y : Authority}
    {p : Nat} (_hsh : k.SharedMutable p) (hab : a ≠ b) (hx : s.A[a]? = some x)
    (hy : s.A[b]? = some y) (xa : x.active = true) (ya : y.active = true)
    (xp : p ∈ x.footprint) (yp : p ∈ y.footprint) (hnab : a ∉ s.ancs b) (hnba : b ∉ s.ancs a) :
    x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe :=
  h a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hnab hnba

/-- Central theorem (MM-03.3 §5): in a state satisfying `Inv3base`, an authorised ordinary write
coexists with no other authority with a present effective mode on the written leaves. The proof
uses only the effective `Modify` of the writer. -/
theorem write3_exclusive {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} (hinv : Inv3base s)
    (h : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s')) : ∀ p ∈ ls, ∀ b, b ≠ a → effective s b p = none := by
  intro p hp b hb
  obtain ⟨⟨-, hw⟩, -⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact effective_exclusive hinv.1 (Ne.symm hb) (hw p hp).1

/-! ## Arena (MM-03.3 §6, A10) -/

/-- The place of the arena value: the owner of its storage (A10). -/
def arenaValue (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Option Nat :=
  match s.P[ar.storage]? with
  | some pl =>
    match pl.owner with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none

/-- Metadata leaves of the arena: the footprint of the arena value (A10). -/
def metaLeaves (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : List Nat :=
  match arenaValue s ar with
  | some v => footprint s.P v
  | none => []

/-- The place `q` exists and is owned by a place (A10: the storage of an arena is owned by the
arena value). -/
def OwnedStorage (s : S3) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.P[q]?) (fun pl => pl.owner.isPlace = true) False

instance (s : S3) (q : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedStorage s q) := by
  unfold OwnedStorage; infer_instance

theorem OwnedStorage.of_P {s s' : S3} {q : Nat} (h : OwnedStorage s q)
    (hP : s'.P[q]? = s.P[q]?) : OwnedStorage s' q := by
  unfold OwnedStorage at h ⊢; rw [hP]; exact h

/-- Arena invariant (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3). Clauses of §6: issued regions within the administered
storage (the footprint of `internal`); two simultaneously valid issued regions disjoint;
available regions disjoint from the still distributed ones; added: available regions within the
storage. Clauses of A10: each emission is a `Modify` authority derived from `internal` on its
region; the storage is owned by a place, the arena value. D3: `internal` is a `Modify` authority
held by the owner of the storage and covering exactly its footprint: its root for an allocated
root, the block for an arena nested in a block of another arena, so neither a root place nor an
authority without origin is required (A10 asked both). -/
def ArenaInv (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Prop :=
  (∀ l ∈ ar.available, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  ar.issued.Pairwise (fun e e' => s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ ar.available) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some ar.internal ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify) ∧
  OwnedStorage s ar.storage ∧
  (∃ (y : Authority) (pl : Place), s.A[ar.internal]? = some y ∧ s.P[ar.storage]? = some pl ∧
    y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder = pl.owner) ∧
  (∀ l, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P ar.storage)

/-- Right to update the metadata of the arena (A10; C6, aligned with `ProviderRight`): exercisable
`Modify` on the arena value, or an authority `via` exercisable at `Observe` (B2) with a present
effective mode on every metadata leaf, all `SharedMutable` (a `writeShared`, A9), with valid
dependencies. -/
def MetaRight (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s ar) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False ∨
  (s.ExercisableAt via .observe ∧ arenaValue s ar ≠ none ∧
    ∀ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar, effective s via l ≠ none ∧ k.SharedMutable l ∧ DepsValid s l)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (MetaRight k s ar via) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Static preconditions of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right (A10); the
region lies in the storage administered by `internal`; the destination `dst` of the block is
usable, exercisable in `Modify` (A2) and holds no initialised value. -/
def IssueStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧ s.Active ar.internal ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssueStatic k s ar via region dst) := by
  unfold IssueStatic; infer_instance

/-- The region is available (MM-03.3 §6): otherwise `issue` fails (A10). -/
def Avail (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ ar.available

instance (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail ar region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-- The abstraction has, through `internal`, effective `Modify` on the region (MM-03.3 §6:
the abstraction has the authority needed to distribute the region). The
disjointness from active emissions is removed (A11): it follows from this right
(`issue_disjoint_redundant`). -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s ar region) := by
  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): a `Modify` block derived from `internal`
on the region, held by the destination value; the destination and the metadata become `Init`;
the region leaves `available` and joins `issued`. -/
def issueEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some ar.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ with
      I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∨ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar then .init else s.I l },
   { ar with
      available := ar.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
      issued := (region, s.A.length) :: ar.issued })

/-- Outcomes of `issue` (A10): `ok`, defined failure `fail` with the state unchanged, `reject`
(pass-1 arbitrage 6). -/
inductive IOutcome where
  | ok (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | fail (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | reject

/-- `arena.issue` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10): `reject` when a static precondition fails;
`fail`, with the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable; `reject` when the region is
available but `internal` lacks the right to distribute it; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    IOutcome → Prop where
  | ok : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s
        (.ok (issueEff s ar region dst).1 (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
  | fail : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → ¬ Avail ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s ar)
  | reject : ¬ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noRight : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → ¬ IssueRight s ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject

/-- Determinism of `issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_det {k : K} {ar : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s : S3}
    {o₁ o₂ : IOutcome} (h₁ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₁)
    (h₂ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- `ok` outcome of `arena.issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_ok_iff {k : K} {ar ar' : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar') ↔ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧
      Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧ (s', ar') = issueEff s ar region dst := by
  constructor
  · intro h; cases h with
    | ok h1 h2 h3 => exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, e⟩
    have e1 := congrArg Prod.fst e; have e2 := congrArg Prod.snd e
    simp only at e1 e2; subst e1 e2; exact .ok h1 h2 h3

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right; no active authority
derived from `internal`; no usable place anchored on `internal` or on an authority derived from
it. -/
def ResetPre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ar.internal ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, x ≠ ar.internal ∧ ar.internal ∉ s.ancs x)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (ResetPre k s ar via) := by
  unfold ResetPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): the whole storage becomes available, the past
emissions are forgotten, the metadata become `Init`. -/
def resetEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s with I := fun l => if l ∈ metaLeaves s ar then .init else s.I l },
   { ar with available := s.afp ar.internal, issued := [] })

/-- `arena.reset` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
def ResetStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 (S3 × Arena) → Prop :=
  Guarded (ResetPre k s ar via) (resetEff s ar)

/-! ## Witnesses of the questions of pass 4 -/

/-- On every reached state (MM-03.3.1; D1), the base frame is 0 and stays at the bottom of the
stack, `nF` is positive, the static places keep their indices, and frame 0 owns directly exactly
the static elements without owning element: `enterFrame` gives its locals the new frame or a place
as owner (A5), `alloc` and `transfer` only give places, and the exit never pops the last frame
(O7). The places frame 0 owns transitively (`OwnedByFrame`) are those and the storage they own. -/
theorem reachable_base_owns_statics {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    s.F.getLast? = some 0 ∧ 0 < s.nF ∧ statics.length ≤ s.P.length ∧
      ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place), s.P[q]? = some pl →
        (pl.owner = .frame 0 ↔
          q < statics.length ∧ ((statics.map (·.1))[q]?).bind (·.2.1) = none) := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh =>
    refine ⟨rfl, Nat.zero_lt_one, Nat.le_of_eq (init_len statics).symm, fun q pl hq => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨hql, rfl⟩ := init_P_get hq
    simp only [shapeOwner]
    split
    · rename_i o ho
      exact ⟨fun e => (by cases e), fun ⟨_, h⟩ => (by rw [ho] at h; cases h)⟩
    · rename_i ho
      exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨hql, ho⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩
  | derive _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact ih
  | split _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact ih
  | @release s s' a _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    unfold releaseEff; split <;> exact ih
  | @transfer s s' src dst _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine ⟨ih.1, ih.2.1, by rw [transfer_len]; exact ih.2.2.1, fun q pl hq => ?_⟩
    rw [transfer_P_get] at hq
    obtain ⟨pl₀, h₀, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hq
    have e := ih.2.2.2 q pl₀ h₀
    split
    · rename_i hh
      have hp : pl₀.owner ≠ .frame 0 := fun e' => by rw [e'] at hh; exact hh
      simp only [reduceCtorEq, false_iff]
      exact fun h' => hp (e.2 h')
    · exact e
  | depend _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact ih
  | @enter s s' ps ls _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨?_, by simp [enterEff], ?_, fun q pl hq => ?_⟩
    · show (s.nF :: s.F).getLast? = some 0
      cases hF : s.F with
      | nil => rw [hF] at h1; cases h1
      | cons a l => rw [hF] at h1; rw [List.getLast?_cons_cons]; exact h1
    · show statics.length ≤ (enterP s ls).length
      rw [enterP_len]; omega
    · rcases enterP_get (show (enterP s ls)[q]? = some pl from hq) with ⟨-, hq'⟩ | ⟨hge, i, -, -, rfl⟩
      · exact h4 q pl hq'
      · have : ¬ q < statics.length := by omega
        simp only [this, false_and, iff_false]
        simp only [localOwner]; split
        · simp
        · intro e; injection e with e; omega
  | @exit s s' _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    unfold exitEff
    unfold ExitPre at hpre
    split
    · rename_i f F₀ hF
      rw [hF] at hpre
      obtain ⟨hne, -⟩ := hpre
      refine ⟨?_, ih.2.1, ih.2.2⟩

/-- `static_pinned_never_exits` has content on a reached state (C5; D1): `K.Pinned` is not empty,

theorem staticPinned_reached :
    Reachable KPS stPin sp1 ∧ KPS.Pinned 0 ∧ StaticPinnedBottom KPS sp1 ∧
      ExitStep KPS sp1 (.ok (exitEff sp1)) ∧
      ∀ q, sp1.Usable q → ¬ ({ sp1 with F := [0] } : S3).Usable q →
        ∀ l ∈ footprint sp1.P q, ¬ KPS.Pinned l := by
  have hr : Reachable KPS stPin sp1 := .enter (.init (by decide)) (.ok (by decide))
  have hsp : StaticPinnedBottom KPS sp1 := by
    intro l hl

    subst this
    exact ⟨0, by decide, show OwnedByFrame sp1.P 0 0 from .frame (pl := ⟨none, .frame 0, 0⟩)

    static_pinned_never_exits (reachable_access_invariant_underDD (KT_dd [] [0] [] [] []) hr).1 hsp

instance (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Decidable (AnchorMoves s src x) := by
  unfold AnchorMoves; infer_instance

/-- Anchors of the places whose frame changes when the value at `src` is transferred (A5;
MM-03.3.6): `src`, its parts, and the usable places it owns, transitively. An anchor of a dead
owned place is not read: no usable place depends on it (MM-03.3.6). -/
def movedDeps (s : S3) (src : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q =>
    decide (partOf s.P q src ∨ (OwnedWithin s src q ∧ s.Usable q))).flatMap s.D

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (MM-03.3 §3, O4), in order: source usable (MM-03.3.1) and
1 initialised; 2 destination usable, without an `Init` leaf, sharing no leaf with the source,
and still usable once it owns the source's storage (no ownership cycle); exercisable `Modify`
on the source and on the destination (B2); 4 no active derived
access on the source other than those it holds; 5 anchors of the value valid; 6 non-escape
(MM-03.3.6) towards the destination's frame, for the anchors of the value and of the usable
places it owns, whose frame changes with it (A5), each frame read after the transfer (B7);
7 no leaf of the source pinned, statically
(`Pinned`, MM-03.3.8) or dynamically (A8); B8 on the effective anchor (C1): for every dependent
usable after the transfer, if its effective anchor moves with the value, or if the dependent
itself moves (the destination, or a place the value owns), the frame of the effective anchor is
the dependent's frame or an ancestor of it, both frames read after the transfer
(`EffAnchorOK`). O4.3 holds by construction. -/
def TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable src ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
  HasRight s .modify src ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧
  (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ depsOf s src, s.Active x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src,
    NoEscape (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe dst)) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
    ∀ x ∈ (transferEff s src dst).D q,
      (AnchorMoves s src (s.effAnchor x) ∨ q = dst ∨ OwnedWithin s src q) →
      EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q))

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) := by
  unfold TransferPre; infer_instance

/-- `transfer` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O4). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

    ((∃ l ∈ y.footprint, EndingLeaf s p l) ∨ ∃ a ∈ s.ancs j, EndUseReleased s p a) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold EndUseAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives the end of the value at `p` (A6): not held within `p`, not the root of
`p`, with a holder that stays live. -/
def EndUseAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧ ¬ IsRootOf s p y ∧
    HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `endUse p` (A6). Usability of the anchored places is read after the end:
a place that dies with `p` has no usable dependent afterwards. In order: `p` usable;
exercisable `Modify` on `p` (A2);
no active derived authority on an ending leaf, or descending from an authority that the end
releases (MM-03.3 §3, O3.2), held elsewhere than in `p` and staying live; no
usable place anchored on an authority held by `p`, on its root, or held by a holder that dies;
C5: no ending leaf pinned, dynamically (A8) or statically (`Pinned`), whatever `ExternalDone`
says: external obligations end only through `unpin`. The ending leaves include those of the
owned places, which die (A6). C8: `p` itself stays usable, its leaves `Uninit`. -/
def EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, EndUseAccessOK s p j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q,
    EndUseAnchorOK s p x) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (p : Nat) :
    Decidable (EndUsePre k s p) := by
  unfold EndUsePre; infer_instance

/-- `endUse` as a relation (A6). -/
def EndUseStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EndUsePre k s p) (endUseEff s p)

theorem endUseS_releases (s : S3) (p : Nat) : OnlyReleases s (endUseS s p) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [endUseS], fun j z hz => ?_⟩

/-- `enterFrame` lays out its locals as a shape (C6). -/
theorem enterP_eq_shapeP (s : S3) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
    enterP s ls = shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls := rfl

/-- Well-formed shape at offset `n` (MM-03.3 §4, O6; C6): the parent and the owning element of an
element are earlier elements, and a part has the owning element of its parent. It is the clause
of `EnterPre` on the locals (`enterPre_shapeOK`). -/
def ShapeOK (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i ∧
      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - n]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => n ≤ o ∧ o < n + i) True

instance (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (ShapeOK n ls) := by
  unfold ShapeOK; infer_instance

theorem enterPre_shapeOK {s : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (h : EnterPre s ps ls) : ShapeOK s.P.length ls := h.2.2

/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (B5; C6; D2): the allocator value at
`provider` is usable, with the right to update its metadata; the place `owner`, which receives
the ownership, is usable, with exercisable `Modify`; the leaves of the provider are `Init`; the
shape is well-formed and not empty (D2: an allocation of size zero is a shape of one leaf). -/
def AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
    (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.Usable provider ∧ ProviderRight k s provider ∧ s.Usable owner ∧ HasRight s .modify owner ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls ∧ ls ≠ []

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
    (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) := by
  unfold AllocStatic; infer_instance

/-- Places after `alloc` (B5; C6): the elements of the shape appended, those without owning
element owned by `owner`. -/
def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Place :=
  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls

/-- Effect of `alloc provider owner shape` (B5; C6): the elements of the shape appended as places
of fresh identities, `Uninit`, without anchor, alive, not freed, not pinned; one root authority
`Modify` per root element, on its footprint, held by the owner of the element (A4); the metadata
of the provider, its leaves, set to `Init`. The shape is abstract: it fixes neither alignment nor
layout (milestone 2). -/
def allocEff (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := allocP s owner ls
    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P provider then .init else s.I l
    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
        shapeOwner ls (.place owner) i, true⟩
    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
    freed := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.freed q
    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q }

/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (B5; C6; C9): `reject` when a static precondition
fails; `fail`, with the state unchanged, when the allocator contract cannot satisfy the request in
the current state (`Satisfiable`); `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
    (s : S3) : AOutcome → Prop where
  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s provider owner ls))
  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.fail s)
  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject

/-- Determinism of `alloc` (B5). -/
theorem alloc_det {k : K} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {s : S3}
    {o₁ o₂ : AOutcome} (h₁ : AllocStep k pr ow ls s o₁) (h₂ : AllocStep k pr ow ls s o₂) :
    o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- `alloc_fail_unchanged` (B5; C9): a failed allocation leaves the state unchanged, and happens
exactly when the static preconditions hold and the allocator contract cannot satisfy the request
in the current state. -/
theorem alloc_fail_unchanged {k : K} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    {s s' : S3} (h : AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.fail s')) :
    s' = s ∧ AllocStatic k s pr ow ls ∧ ¬ k.Satisfiable pr ls s := by
  cases h with
  | fail h1 h2 => exact ⟨rfl, h1, h2⟩

237:4. **Paramètres (A3).** Un paramètre est une autorité active, dérivée (`origin ≠ none`) et détenue par le cadre appelant. `enterFrame` en fait le nouveau cadre détenteur. Une racine ne peut pas être passée : A4, « n'est jamais transférée seule ». Le retour est un `transfer` vers un emplacement résultat de l'appelant, sur lequel l'appelé détient le paramètre `Modify` (cas 8, 16, n2, n3, n9).

Une valeur ancrée sur la racine de son propre stockage possédé est donc refusée au retour, alors que cette racine est détenue par la valeur et part avec elle. La même valeur ancrée sur un accès dérivé de cette racine est acceptée, et après la sortie son ancre est cette même racine (témoins `ne0`, `ne1`). findings.evidence: Report: "dans le modèle, l'enfant a toujours la valeur arène du parent (`nested_same_value`)" (l.28). "L'enfant a donc la valeur arène du parent (`nested_same_value`) : … l'`endUse` de l'enfant finit le parent" (l.164). "Un enfant a donc la valeur arène de son parent, et son `endUse` finit les deux (`nested_same_value`)" (l.183). nested_same_value only proves `arenaValue s par = arenaValue s child`, under `WF3 s` and an explicit shared-leaf hypothesis `l ∈ footprint s.P par.storage`, `l ∈ footprint s.P child.storage`. The following steps are argued in prose, not stated in Lean: (1) that a nested arena's storage always shares a leaf with the parent's; (2) that endUse of that value ends both entries; (3) that the parent's reset is then rejected. The module has no example on `endUseEff nA5 _` (grep). The claim is true on the witness. In a scratch file I checked, all accepted: `EndUseStep K0 0 nA5 (.ok (endUseEff nA5 0))`, `¬ (endUseEff nA5 0).Active 2 ∧ ¬ (endUseEff nA5 0).Active 3`, and `ResetAtStep K0 0 0 (endUseEff nA5 0) .reject`. So the general 'non réalisable' rests on nested_same_value plus arena_dies_with_internal plus the liveness requirement of ResetAtPre, assembled informally.
findings.suggested_fix: Say that the impossibility is argued. Cite arena_dies_with_internal and ResetAtPre for 'son endUse finit les deux'. Or add the witness facts above (endUse of the shared value kills both internals; reset of the parent is then rejected) to the nested-arena section.

findings.evidence: Row r5 of the report: "exécution de Reachable KA [] et liste d'arènes non vide à chaque état vérifié (case16_reachable)". The run checks verdicts on a0 (Write3Step, l.8355), a1 (AllocStep, l.8356) and a2 (NewArenaStep, l.8358). I ran `#eval (a0.arenas.length, a1.arenas.length, a2.arenas.length)` and got `(0, 0, 0)`. case16_reachable (l.8374-8376) only states `a3.arenas ≠ [] ∧ a6… ∧ … a11.arenas ≠ []`. It says nothing about the two checked intermediate states `deriveEff a3 0 0 .observe` (DeriveStep, l.8361) and `deriveEff (deriveEff a3 0 0 .observe) 2 2 .modify` (EnterStep, l.8363). The report claims more than that.

findings.title: The 'Classement' of r8 (and of the r3 read/write row) does not follow the pass-4 convention for kernel verdicts on a state built with a test contract
findings.location: formal/reports/MM03_v0.1_p5.md (g), rows r8 (line 222) and r3 second line (line 216)
findings.evidence: Pass-4 (g), row q2: a kernel verdict (ReleaseStep, which has no K) on the state of case 6 built with KA is classified "noyau, sur l'état du cas 6 (`KA`)". Pass-5 r8 has the same situation: Write3Step 3 [4, 5] a9 .reject and Write3Step 3 [5] a9 ok (MM03.lean:8405-8406), on the case-16 state a9. Yet it is classified "abstraction (`KA`)". `#check @Write3Step` gives `Nat → List Nat → S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop`, so there is no K parameter and the verdict cannot depend on KA. Likewise, the r3 read/write row is classified "abstraction (`KPS`)". Its verdicts are Read3Step 0 [0] mm0 and Write3Step 0 [0] mm0 (l.8321-8322), with mm0 = S3.init stG (l.8318): no K is involved, and these are the same verdicts as the r1/r2 examples on g0 = S3.init stG. By contrast, the r3 transfer/endUse rows do depend on KPS. I checked `decide (TransferPre K0 mm0 0 1)` = true and with KPS = false; `decide (EndUsePre K0 mm0 0)` = true and with KPS = false.
findings.suggested_fix: Classify r8 as 'noyau, sur l'état du cas 16 (KA)' and the r3 read/write row as 'noyau'. Keep 'abstraction (KPS)' for the r3 transfer/endUse row.

findings.title: (o) omits alloc_fail_unchanged, a (n).1 statement whose domain changes with D2, and the catch-all row says nothing else changes
findings.evidence: Pass-4 (n) 1 lists "`alloc_fresh`, `alloc_owned_root`, `alloc_fail_unchanged`". Pass-5 (n) 1 takes these over: "Celles de la passe 4, (n) 1, sur le nouveau domaine … entre autres". (o) says a domain changes when a statement "porte … sur une définition que la passe modifie". alloc_fail_unchanged (MM03.lean, `AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.fail s') → s' = s ∧ AllocStatic k s pr ow ls ∧ ¬ k.Satisfiable …`) depends on AllocStatic, which now ends with `ls ≠ []` (l.3929-3932). A failed allocation of the empty shape is therefore no longer in its domain. Report (i) says so itself: "`alloc_fail_unchanged` en dit autant pour `fail`". Yet the (o) row on alloc lists only alloc_preserves, alloc_fresh, alloc_owned_root, alloc_preserves_anchorOrder and alloc_preserves_noDangling. The last row then says of the remaining (n).1 statements "pas d'autre changement".
findings.suggested_fix: Add alloc_fail_unchanged to the (o) row 'Sans la forme vide (D2)'. Its conclusion AllocStatic is also stronger.
